source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given an array of positive integers a1, a2, ..., an × T of length n × T. We know that for any i > n it is true that ai = ai - n. Find the length of the longest non-decreasing sequence of the given array.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print a single number — the length of a sought sequence.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers: n, T (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ T ≤ 107). The second line contains n space-separated integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 300).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteThe array given in the sample looks like that: 3, 1, 4, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2. The elements in bold form the largest non-decreasing subsequence.
